live_after.description: Event watermark captured before reading a latest page. Null on older pages.

next_before.description: Exclusive bound for the next older page. Null means history is exhausted.

intent.description: Omit or null for no intent; otherwise request, inform or ack. Native validation rejects other strings.

reply_to.description: At most 512 UTF-8 bytes; NUL forbidden.

text.description: At most 65536 UTF-8 bytes; blank text requires at least one valid attachment. Native validation enforces byte and attachment constraints.

thread.description: At most 512 UTF-8 bytes; NUL forbidden.

OfficeMessage.description: Accepted message addressing, frozen at submission; does not establish delivery/read.

status.description: queued: native mailbox accepted; never equate this with model execution/success.

RelatedAgent.description: Direct immutable creation provenance; status and office facts are fresh observations.

availability.description: available | unavailable; unavailable never resolves by name.

launch_failure.description: Native failed-start observation, independently of retained conversation availability.

RoleView.description: Safe adopted/current Role metadata; never includes its prompt or instructions.

Usage.description: Parser-normalized cumulative snapshot. Zero does not establish field presence.

availability.description: available | missing | read_failed; a missing sample must not reuse old usage as current.

source_key.description: Opaque native tool/path/session correlation; no filesystem path is published.

info.description: Complete public management projection. Ordinary v1 JSON. Requests require the selected listener authority in Host; Origin, when present, must exactly match that authority. No cross-origin permission or arbitrary actor context. Integer widths/signs come from native types: u-int64/int64 must use lossless JSON parsing and exact bigint conversion; int32/u-int32 are safe numbers. Nullable fields preserve null; missing optional input fields retain native serde defaults. Query keys cannot repeat except label; selectors require current_only=true. AgentRef requires exactly one incarnation/stopped_event; semantic checks remain native. Attachment upload/download use raw bytes. Inspector mutations retain route-specific external tags; internal collection/execution variants are excluded.

x-agentx-codec.decode: Preserve numeric tokens before schema-based conversion; never JSON.parse then BigInt, and never convert digit strings globally.
x-agentx-codec.encode: Emit bigint as unquoted decimal integer tokens only at schema-declared integer fields. Reject fractional/out-of-range values.
x-agentx-codec.identities: Agent incarnation/stopped_event, generation, request_id, message_id and revisions remain opaque strings.
